title: Installing a computed function at a tape seam
statement: Let $F$ be a machine format, let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over Boolean symbols, let $f$ map Boolean words to Boolean words, and let $T$ map natural numbers to natural numbers. Suppose that on every input word $arg$, $M$ halts within $T(|arg|)$ steps with output $f(arg)$. Then there exist a finite Boolean Turing machine $C$, a destination work tape $dst$, entry and exit states, and a natural number $a$, with $dst$ having index $1$, such that for every input word $x$ and argument word $arg$, starting $C$ in its entry state with $arg$ on tape $0$ and all other tapes empty, it reaches within $a(T(|arg|)+|arg|+|f(arg)|+1)$ steps a configuration in the exit state whose tape words are the initial assignment with $f(arg)$ installed on tape $dst$. The exit state is not reached at any earlier time.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Boolean Turing machine
$M$ computes $f$ within time $T$ on every input
